qualifier: cyclooxygenase route to prostaglandins and thromboxanes, with prostanoid receptors
name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and receptors
rationale: All members cover arachidonate release by PLA2, COX conversion to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and prostanoid receptors, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene/lipoxin confusables and from those limited to regulation of prostaglandin secretion.

qualifier: germinal centre, plasma and memory cell differentiation
name: B cell development and germinal centre, plasma, memory differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell lineage signatures and B cell development, proliferation, germinal centre, plasma and memory cell differentiation (with Tfh/ICOS help), whereas confusables centre on proximal BCR/TCR signalling, thymic T cell development or isotype switching.

qualifier: TAK1 activation and AP-1 immediate-early transcription
name: TAK1-driven JNK/p38 stress signalling and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members cover TAK1/ALPK1-driven JNK and p38 activation and its regulation together with AP-1 and growth-factor/TNF-induced immediate-early gene programmes, unlike confusables centred on NOD receptors, UV response or ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: chylomicron/VLDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodelling
name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodelling or clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL; particle assembly and HDL/LDL remodelling are what the lipase- and clearance-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor events
name: ERBB receptor SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor signalling
rationale: Members are SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K docking events downstream of EGFR, ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4 dimers, distinguishing it from confusables on ERBB4 nuclear signalling/downregulation, PLCG1/GRB7/PTK6 branches or MET signalling.

core: Regulation of lymphocyte tolerance and activation
qualifier: costimulatory and NK (KIR) receptor interactions with antigen-presenting cells
name: Costimulatory and NK receptor control of lymphocyte tolerance
rationale: Members concern surface-receptor control of T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, NK activation via KIR/activating receptors and dendritic cell differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise Treg/Th17 differentiation and T cell suppression, NK cytotoxicity, or dendritic cell signatures.

qualifier: fibre differentiation, growth and atrophy in response to activity
name: Skeletal muscle fibre differentiation, growth and atrophy
rationale: Members cover skeletal myogenesis and fibre differentiation (including diaphragm and extraocular muscle), growth, atrophy and responses to activity or inactivity, whereas confusables centre on cardiac muscle adaptation, sarcomere assembly and calcineurin-dependent contraction.

qualifier: multiciliated/ependymal differentiation, CSF flow and sperm motility
name: Multiciliogenesis, ependymal CSF flow and sperm motility
rationale: Members cover multiciliated cell differentiation (centriole and basal body amplification), ventricle development and cerebrospinal fluid circulation, and regulation of cilium and sperm flagellar movement, whereas confusables centre on axonemal dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance.

qualifier: initiation at RNA polymerase III promoters and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III initiation and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are Pol III initiation at type 1-3 promoters (tRNA, snRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA gene transcription, distinguishing them from confusables on Pol III elongation and termination and Pol I rRNA transcription and processing.

qualifier: GPVI and GPIb-IX-V adhesion signalling and degranulation
name: Platelet GPVI/GPIb adhesion signalling, degranulation and aggregation
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion to collagen via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V, PECAM1 interactions, degranulation, aggregation and coagulation, whereas confusables centre on ADP/thrombin/thromboxane GPCR signalling or VWF variants.

qualifier: intestinal epithelial and stem cell homeostasis, microbiota modulation
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides and intestinal epithelial homeostasis
rationale: Members cover alpha/beta-defensin and antimicrobial peptide production and its regulation together with intestinal stem cell, epithelial structure and microbiota maintenance, which confusables on broad mucosal/antifungal defence, metal sequestration or enterocyte differentiation lack.

qualifier: decapping-initiated, deadenylation-independent
name: Deadenylation-independent decapping and 5'-to-3' mRNA decay
rationale: All three members describe cap removal and XRN-type 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic mRNA decay without prior deadenylation, unlike confusables on deadenylation, ARE-binding protein control, mRNA stabilisation or snRNA cap/spliceosome processes.

qualifier: xylulose-5-phosphate formation via glucuronate route and non-oxidative shunt
name: Xylulose-5-phosphate and non-oxidative pentose phosphate interconversions
rationale: Members cover xylulose-5-phosphate formation (glucuronate-xylulose route, pentosuria) and the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt (RPIA, TALDO1 defects), distinguishing them from confusables on fructose, alditol, glycerol and galactose metabolism.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
name: Hedgehog SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
rationale: Members centre on Hedgehog reception, SMO activation and ciliary localisation and proteasome-dependent GLI1/2 degradation and GLI3 processing (with related proteasomal DVL turnover), unlike confusables on canonical Wnt/Notch, Hh ligand lipidation and release, or planar cell polarity.

qualifier: OTU-domain proteases, K11- and K48-linked chains
name: OTU deubiquitinase removal of K11/K48-linked ubiquitin
rationale: Members are OTU-domain deubiquitinases and K11/K48-linked deubiquitination, distinguishing them from confusables on ubiquitin chain synthesis, USP/UCH/Josephin/JAMM DUB families, or NF-kappaB control.

qualifier: host cell entry and subversion of apoptosis, autophagy and phagolysosome fusion
name: Intracellular bacterial entry and subversion of host defences
rationale: Members describe how intracellular bacteria (Listeria InlB entry, M. tuberculosis) enter host cells and suppress apoptosis, autophagy, phagolysosome fusion, nitric oxide and membrane repair, whereas confusables centre on adhesion, phagosome acidification, ion flux or bacterial toxins.

core: Type I interferon induction by dsRNA sensing
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 via TBK1/IKKe-IRF3
name: dsRNA sensing driving TBK1/IKKε-IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 responses to dsRNA and their regulation converging on TBK1/IKKe-mediated IRF3/IRF7 activation and type I IFN induction, unlike confusables on downstream ISG responses, RLR-NF-kB/viral evasion, or cGAS/STING and IFN-beta regulation.

qualifier: TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 branch with TGFBR3, RUNX3 and cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 signalling, regulation and cancer mutants
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta and activin receptor-SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signalling, its positive and negative regulation (TGFBR3, follistatin, RUNX3 targets) and cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs, distinguishing it from Hippo/YAP, MET and BMP confusables.

qualifier: generation, transport and receptor signalling
name: Thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signalling
rationale: All members concern thyroid hormone synthesis (including iodide transporter defects), transport, activity and receptor-mediated responses, which confusables on H2O2 metabolism, selenium metabolism and growth hormone/prolactin/leptin signalling lack.

qualifier: semaphorin-plexin signalling (Sema3A, Sema4D, RND1)
name: Semaphorin-plexin repulsion in axon guidance and cell migration
rationale: Members are semaphorin-plexin signalling events (Sema3A/CRMP/PAK, Sema4D growth-cone collapse, RND1) and the axon guidance and innervation they drive, distinguishing the theme from netrin and ephrin repulsion confusables.

qualifier: classical antibody-mediated route to C3/C5 activation and opsonisation
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonisation
rationale: Members cover classical antibody-triggered complement activation, C3 and C5 activation and opsonisation (with complement gene modules), whereas confusables centre on the alternative pathway and positive/negative regulation of the cascade.

qualifier: SREBP transcriptional control of ER cholesterol biosynthesis
name: SREBP-driven cholesterol biosynthesis and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SREBP activation and target-gene programmes (SREBF motifs, ER modules), regulation of cholesterol biosynthesis and intracellular cholesterol transport, distinguishing the theme from ATF6/CREB3 ER stress, reverse cholesterol transport, fatty acid and vitamin D confusables.

qualifier: phenylalanine and tyrosine, with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor synthesis
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine hydroxylation (phenylketonuria), tyrosine catabolism and synthesis/recycling of the BH4 cofactor, which confusables on sulfur amino acid, selenium, vitamin B6 and generic amino acid metabolism lack.

qualifier: integrin and S1P-dependent migration into developing lymphoid tissues
name: Integrin/S1P lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover integrin- and S1P-receptor-dependent lymphocyte homing, B cell chemotaxis and marginal zone B cells, and lymph node, MALT and gut lymphoid tissue development, whereas confusables centre on chemokine signalling, T cell synapse adhesion or endothelial extravasation.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens to NKT cells, with TLR7/8 dendritic receptors
name: CD1 lipid antigen presentation and NKT cell activation
rationale: Members cover lipid antigen presentation via CD1/MHC class Ib, regulation of NKT cell activation, proliferation and differentiation, and DC receptor/TLR7-8 modules, unlike confusables on MHC class II peptide presentation, monocyte signatures or Th1/IL-12 responses.
